title: Agent Composition Disclosure
description: What the director tells the user BEFORE dispatching any implementer for a batch of tasks. One disclosure per batch, not per individual spawn. See DELEGATION-PROTOCOL.md. Work does not start until this has been stated. If subagent_count exceeds the active profile's director.max_batch_agents, this notice also doubles as an approval request — dispatch does not start until approval_status is granted.

task.description: task_id or short description this subagent owns.

justification.description: Why this task needs its own subagent — not foldable into another task in this same batch, and not better handled as part of one broader task contract. 'Smaller diffs' or 'tidier task IDs' alone is not sufficient; see DELEGATION-PROTOCOL.md's minimality principle.

subagents.description: One entry per subagent about to be spawned, with the task each owns.

parallel.description: Whether these subagents run concurrently (per CONCURRENCY-RULES.md conflict-domain check) or sequentially.

rescue_agent_available.description: Whether a Rescue Agent promotion (RESCUE-PROTOCOL.md) is actually available in this session/environment if a task fails twice — e.g. whether a stronger model tier is reachable at all.

within_preapproved_range.description: True if subagent_count is within the active profile's director.max_batch_agents. If false, this notice is also an approval request — see approval_status.

approval_status.description: not_required when within_preapproved_range is true. Otherwise starts at 'pending' and dispatch does not start until it becomes 'granted'.
